# SahayakAI

> The Operating System for Teaching in India

SahayakAI is a voice-first AI platform for schools and teachers in India. It supports teachers in preparing and assessing lessons and keeps parents informed through AI-assisted calls, so that school, teacher and parent work together on each student's development. It is a product of SARGVISION Intelligence, a DPIIT-recognised education technology company based in Bengaluru, founded by Abhishek Gupta.

## Who It Is For

SahayakAI serves all Indian teachers and schools from Class 1 to Class 12: CBSE and ICSE schools, state board schools, government and private institutions, single schools and school chains. Schools adopt it for their teaching staff; school leadership receives an administrative view of adoption.

## What SahayakAI Does

- Parent communication: AI-assisted calls and messages to parents in the parent's own language, for example a welfare check when a student has been absent for several days, or a reminder before a parent-teacher meeting
- VIDYA: a voice assistant available on every screen that takes a spoken request and opens or completes the right task
- Exam paper generator: complete examination papers with marking schemes that follow board paper patterns
- AI coach: professional development guidance for teachers, aligned with the National Education Policy 2020
- Lesson plans, quizzes, worksheets and rubrics aligned to the curriculum
- Visual aids, virtual field trips and curated video recommendations
- Assessment support for handwritten student work
- Attendance records with parent outreach
- A community library where teachers share and reuse each other's material

## Languages

English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Malayalam and Odia.

## Curriculum Coverage

NCERT, CBSE, ICSE and state boards, Classes 1 to 12, across the major school subjects.

## Access And Pricing

SahayakAI is provided to schools. Access is by school onboarding or approved request. Pricing is quoted per school; see https://www.sahayakai.com/school-pricing.
